name: Padini Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026 年 Padini Holdings Berhad 未公布新增业务线、产能扩张、出售或退出业务的公告；所获公告主要为股息、股东大会及一般性事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比下降 6.7%，净利润转为亏损 964.3 万 MYR；全年营收 18.75 亿 MYR，净利润 1.13 亿 MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, Padini Holdings Berhad did not announce any new business lines, capacity expansion, disposals or exits; announcements were mainly dividends, general meetings and general matters. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue fell 6.7% YoY and net profit turned to a loss of MYR 9.643 million; full-year revenue was MYR 1.875 billion with net profit of MYR 112.621 million.
